errors.description: The wavy fish-mouth shaped edge runs the full depth of the fly opening down to the crotch, whereas the blueprint's red wave occupies roughly the upper third of the fly before straightening.
errors.expected: Wavy fish-mouth notch concentrated where the waistband end meets the fly, easing into a straighter edge lower down.
errors.actual: Continuous shaped curve running the whole depth of the opening.
errors.correction: Acceptable in kind - the distinguishing wavy fish-mouth geometry is present and unmistakable versus the straight-fly sibling. Extent could be shortened on a future pass.
